import unittest

class Contract(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_contract(self):
        import mime as m
        self.assertEqual(m.media_type(' Text/Plain; charset=UTF-8 '), 'text/plain')
        self.assertEqual(m.media_type('application/json'), 'application/json')
        self.assertEqual(m.media_type(''), '')
    def test_dispatch(self):
        from handlers import select, decode
        exact = lambda value: None
        major = lambda value: ''
        any_type = lambda value: 'any:' + value
        fallback = lambda value: 'fallback:' + value
        rules = {'text/plain': exact, 'text/*': major, '*/*': any_type}
        self.assertIs(select(' Text/Plain; charset=UTF-8', rules, fallback), exact)
        self.assertIsNone(decode('x', 'text/plain', rules, fallback))
        self.assertEqual(decode('x', 'TEXT/HTML', rules, fallback), '')
        self.assertEqual(decode('x', 'application/json', rules, fallback), 'any:x')
        self.assertEqual(decode('x', 'application/json', {}, fallback), 'fallback:x')
        self.assertEqual(set(rules), {'text/plain', 'text/*', '*/*'})
